Son of Elimelech and Naomi, and the husband of Orpah the Moabitess.
Husband of Naomi and father-in-law of Ruth the Moabitess. He was the father of Mahlon and Chilion.
A woman of the tribe of Judah, one of the wives of Caleb the son of Hezron, and mother of Hur.

Son of Elimelech and Naomi, and the first husband of Ruth the Moabitess. He died childless in Moab but Boaz continued his family line by marrying Ruth.
Married to Elimelech, she was the mother of Mahlon and Chilion. Her daughter-in-law was Ruth, great-grandmother of King David.
Son of Boaz and Ruth, father of Jesse, and grandfather of King David.
Moabite wife of Chilion and sister-in-law of Ruth.
A son of Judah by Tamar, and brother to Zerah. He is listed in the family line of Jesus.
Daughter of Laban, and the second and favorite wife of Jacob. She was the mother of Joseph and Benjamin. Her slave Bilhah was the mother of Dan and Naphtali.
